comment: No source is published. There is no manual, no README and no res/ documentation. Panel lettering came from the VCV library screenshot at https://library.vcvrack.com/screenshots/400/DigitalAtavism/Blip.png because the plugin ships no panel SVG at all — the panels are drawn at runtime by Blip::Widget::draw. Parameter 3 is configured by the count passed to config() but never given a configParam or a ParamWidget, so it has no name, no tooltip and no position, and cannot be clicked; outputs 0 and 1 are the same, leftovers of the shared layout with Coin. The oscillator runs at eight times the engine rate and the eight sub-samples are averaged. The trigger threshold is Rack's usual rescale of 0.1 to 2.0 volts. The envelope has two timed stages, hold then release; the hold stage adds a punch term, which on this module is stored as zero, so the hold is flat.
